column1: # MOADIX gate-owned ZAP rules (increment 7d, ruling 4). zap-baseline.py -c format: id TAB action TAB (name).
# The gate applies the same file to ZAP's JSON report (check_exec.parse_zap): any High alert fails whatever
# this file says; a rule set to FAIL fails at any risk; IGNORE is counted and not listed; WARN and INFO are
# reported. Rules not listed are WARN. The app is scanned over plain HTTP on the run's internal network, so
# rules that only make sense over TLS are IGNORE.
